fonts.display: 'Jannon Neo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Modale Antique', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Aubergine Ink
palette.role: Primary text, headings, filled action buttons, footer text — the warm near-black that anchors every screen; it is the only chromatic dark in the system and the only acceptable fill for primary actions

palette.name: Vintage Burgundy
palette.role: Orange wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content.

palette.name: Buttery Highlight
palette.role: Link text and selected heading accent — a pale custard yellow used sparingly to mark hyperlinks and tiny editorial highlights, sitting at AAA contrast on the ink

palette.name: Parchment Canvas
palette.role: Page background — the dominant warm cream that defines the entire site mood; every screen sits on this surface

palette.name: Linen Card
palette.role: Card surfaces, list-item backgrounds, subtle elevated zones — a step lighter than the canvas, the only card treatment in the system

palette.name: Hairline Mist
palette.role: All borders and dividers throughout the system; used on cards, body blocks, links, and structural dividers — the single hairline color of the site

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Button borders, reverse text on dark fills, and the lightest possible surface lift; the only true white in the palette
